description: Look up a job by id. action=status (default) returns its status and result once finished; set wait (seconds) to hold the request until the job reaches a terminal status. action=explain returns the ordered per-stage timing breakdown, useful when a job was slow or failed. Job ids come from async scrape, crawl, batch and SERP responses.

wait.description: status only: long-poll up to this many seconds

name: alterlab_job
title: Job Status
